PASSED IN L.A.C.
NO.33/2015, DATED 02/12/2019, BY THE HONBLE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC AT KUNIGAL ANN-A BY FIXING THE THAN PREVAILING MARKET VALUE OF THE PETITIONERS PROPERTY WAS VALUED MORE THAN RS. 50,000/- GUNTA.
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.G.S. KAMAL
ORAL ORDER Petitioners are before this Court being aggrieved by the order dated 02.12.2019 passed in LAC No.33/2015 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, JMFC, Kunigal under Section 18(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 seeking following reliefs;
"a. Issue a writ in the nature of Certiorari or any other appropriate writ, quashing /setting-aside the impugned order passed in LAC No.33/2015 dated 02.12.2019 by the Hon'ble Senior Civil Judge and JMFC at Kunigal at Annexure-A by fixing the prevailing market value of the petitioner's property was valued more than Rs.50,000/- gunta."
2.
The petition essentially seeking enhancement of compensation awarded by the respondent No.1-SLAO and re- NC: 2025:KHC:5448 determined by LAC Court as above which is required to be adjudicated as provided under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
